india.one_line: India sees AI growth with new supercluster, defence trust framework, and startups launching privacy and fintech solutions.

themes.title: Privacy‑focused AI assistant unveiled
themes.text: Eternal unveiled Dark, a privacy‑focused AI assistant that uses end‑to‑end encryption and an encrypted memory layer. The service is in internal use and aims for a global launch in 2026.

stories.headline: Eternal unveils Dark, a privacy‑focused AI assistant, aims for global launch in 2026

themes.title: Fintech AI startup secures seed funding
themes.text: Karta AI raised $3 million in a seed round led by PeerCapital and Cedar Hill Capital to automate complex inbound banking calls. Its platform handles about 2 million monthly conversations across 25 languages, resolves roughly 70% of queries, and cuts query costs by about half.

stories.headline: Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls

themes.title: New AI supercluster launched in Chennai
themes.text: Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai equipped with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, each featuring 288 GB HBM3E memory. The deployment is the largest AMD Instinct installation in India and one of the world’s biggest.

stories.headline: Vultr launches 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs

themes.title: India adopts AI defence trust framework
themes.text: India created a domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence, built on reliability, safety and transparency. The country also co‑sponsored the first UN informal exchange on AI in the military domain.

stories.headline: India creates domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence
